scope: CVG-003 bounded transaction-level authorization linearization for protected application writes

criteria.description: The final-guard-to-protected-write race, bounded scope, owner, authority and explicit non-claims are recorded without promoting CVG-003 or product readiness.
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes only the protected application-write boundary; read-only access, direct SQL/admin writes, target behavior, providers, production and release remain excluded.

criteria.description: The existing mutating-route tenant unit-of-work, active transaction scope and final requirePrincipal boundary provide a coherent insertion point for an account-scoped transaction advisory lock.
criteria.limitations: The lock is valid only while the existing application transaction is active; no new transaction protocol is introduced for GET/read-only routes or bypass paths.

criteria.description: Rejecting unit and real PostgreSQL/two-instance HTTP tests exist for fail-closed scope handling and revocation committing during a paused protected write; the current implementation fails the behavioral race before the lock is added.
criteria.limitations: The RED evidence is disposable local PostgreSQL/HTTP evidence. GREEN implementation, independent review, regressions and artifact reconciliation are required before a verified slice can be recorded.

gaps: The lock helper and final-guard wiring are not implemented yet.
Independent review and post-implementation regression evidence are not complete.

authority.scope: CVG-003 transaction-level authorization linearization for protected application writes
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation and disposable PostgreSQL/two-instance HTTP verification of the bounded account-scoped transaction advisory-lock authorization boundary; direct SQL, read-only authorization, providers, credentials, production, deployment, external mutation and release remain excluded.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before expanding to read authorization, worker/direct SQL paths, target operations, external providers, credentials, production, deployment or release acceptance.

next_action: Implement the smallest transaction-scoped advisory-lock helper and place it before the final fresh authorization read, then run the RED unit and HTTP tests to GREEN.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to tenant unit-of-work transaction scope or protected mutation dispatch
Changes to access-control hydration, revocation mutation or final requirePrincipal ordering
PostgreSQL compatibility, security-review finding or regression involving advisory locks
